title: gametime
summary: MSUI now implements current Benilla's GameTimeFrame from the already authoritative SMSG_LOGIN_SETTIMESPEED clock: exact 50px minimap-relative overhang, hit insets, UI-TOD-Indicator day/night atlas windows, 05:30 dawn and 21:00 dusk boundaries, en-GB 24-hour tooltip formatting, and per-frame live clock updates. GameTimeUiLaw owns the frame size, hit-screen projection, and exact ANCHOR_BOTTOMLEFT tooltip seat; the renderer publishes its white clock line through the shared classic GameTooltip instead of an implicit cursor tooltip and contains no local Vector2 geometry. Focused GameTime and GameTooltip checks pass; live pixel/tooltip verification remains open.

openItems.text: Verify the sun/moon icon, exact inset hover hull and minute-updating tooltip in a live session at dawn, dusk and multiple UI scales.
GameTimeFrame hover used an implicit cursor-positioned ImGui tooltip even though current Benilla explicitly owns GameTooltip with ANCHOR_BOTTOMLEFT.
openItems.resolution: GameTimeUiLaw now maps tooltip TOPRIGHT to the authored 50x50 owner's BOTTOMLEFT, and the renderer submits the formatted white clock line through the shared owner-anchored classic GameTooltip adapter.
